description: Repo-scale (gin-helpdesk): agent deactivation must cascade across list, ticket-creation, and ticket-reassignment call sites
prompts: Add `POST /api/agents/:id/deactivate`, which sets `active` to false. Deactivation must cascade across THREE places: (1) `GET /api/agents` excludes inactive agents by default, but includes them with `?includeInactive=true`; (2) `POST /api/tickets` must reject (400) assigning a ticket to a deactivated agent at creation time; (3) `PATCH /api/tickets/:id` must ALSO reject (400) reassigning a ticket to a deactivated agent - both mutation paths that can newly assign an agent to a ticket must enforce this, not just creation.

reference_solution.internal/api/router.go:
package api

import "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"

func NewRouter() *gin.Engine {
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
	r := gin.New()
	r.Use(gin.Recovery())

	r.POST("/api/agents", createAgent)
	r.GET("/api/agents", listAgents)
	r.GET("/api/agents/:id", getAgent)
	r.POST("/api/agents/:id/deactivate", deactivateAgent)

	r.POST("/api/tickets", createTicket)
	r.GET("/api/tickets", listTickets)
	r.GET("/api/tickets/:id", getTicket)
	r.PATCH("/api/tickets/:id", updateTicket)

	r.POST("/api/tickets/:id/comments", createComment)
	r.GET("/api/tickets/:id/comments", listComments)

	return r
}
